name: Tomas Novak
headline: Infrastructure Engineer
summary: Infrastructure engineer with 10 years running Linux estates for hosting, banking and the public sector. Strong on automation, monitoring and keeping older systems healthy.

experience.title: Infrastructure Engineer
bullets: Maintain 600 Linux servers across two data centres for a shared-hosting provider with 45,000 customers.
Rolled out Ansible playbooks for patching and hardening, cutting monthly maintenance windows from 8 hours to 2.
Tuned Nginx reverse proxies that handle 30,000 requests per second at peak.
Set up Prometheus and Grafana monitoring to replace a legacy Nagios installation.

experience.title: Linux System Administrator
bullets: Administered the Linux hosts behind internet banking, including quarterly disaster-recovery tests.
Automated user and certificate management with Bash scripts, saving 20 hours of manual work a month.
Piloted Docker for internal tools, the bank's first containerised workloads.

experience.title: Junior IT Administrator
bullets: Supported 900 municipal staff on Windows desktops and Linux file servers.
Wrote Bash backup scripts for the file servers and tested restores every month.
Documented the network and server inventory in the team wiki.

education.institution: Brno Secondary School of Electrical Engineering
